messages:
applyPatch: reject sparse and non-plain patches and values, report every failure as JsonPatchError

A sparse patch no longer skips its holes; operations must be plain objects
with an own op; sparse arrays and cyclic structures are not JSON values;
any error raised while applying an operation (getter, proxy, stack
overflow) is wrapped in a JsonPatchError carrying index and cause.
